agents.note: Custom Agent implements a complete LLM -> tools -> model-selected dispatch loop.

mcp.note: Remote streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint, defaulting to a Cloud Run HTTPS URL and overrideable by constructor/environment.

authority.fact: session.list_tools() is converted wholesale into OpenAI tool definitions and exposed to the model.
Model-selected tool calls are dispatched directly through session.call_tool.
No Authorization or other authentication header is configured in the MCP HTTP client.
Streamlit user chat input reaches the custom agent loop.

policy_expectations.reason: Remote MCP is used without recognized authentication.
All remote list_tools results are exposed to the model without an explicit allowlist.
The MCP endpoint can be caller/environment selected and no destination restriction is present.

forbidden_expectations.reason: The default observed endpoint is HTTPS; dynamic override alone does not prove plaintext transport.

unresolved: Remote tool capabilities are not statically known, so destructive/data attack paths cannot be established from this repository alone.
